lang_en:
She called 10,000 steps an easy morning.
I said she takes the lift at work.
She said loser carries both bags.
I shook on it fast.
She booked it for December the same night.
Girnar on NakshIQ: hard.
Fitness level: high.
December, a go. Ten out of ten.
She said, they're just stairs.
By the top, she'd stopped talking.
And she carried both bags. Up and down.
Hard means hard. That's travel intelligence.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
उसने कहा, 10,000 सीढ़ियाँ तो बस सुबह की सैर है।
मैंने कहा, ऑफ़िस में तो तुम लिफ़्ट लेती हो।
वो बोली, जो हारेगा, दोनों बैग वही उठाएगा।
मैंने झट से हाथ मिला लिया।
उसी रात उसने दिसंबर की बुकिंग कर दी।
NakshIQ पर गिरनार: मुश्किल।
फ़िटनेस लेवल: हाई।
दिसंबर में, गो। दस में से दस।
वो बोली, सीढ़ियाँ ही तो हैं।
ऊपर पहुँचते-पहुँचते, उसकी बोलती बंद थी।
और दोनों बैग उसी ने उठाए। ऊपर भी, नीचे भी।
मुश्किल मतलब मुश्किल। यही ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: She called *10,000 steps* | an easy morning.

shots: s1: Morning, their apartment hallway. She ties her shoelaces, waving a hand like it is nothing; he leans on the doorframe, smirking. (covers lines 1-2)
s2: She points at two backpacks on the floor, then at him; he grabs her hand and shakes it fast. (covers lines 3-4)
s3: She taps her phone and turns it toward him, screen away from camera, triumphant. (covers line 5)
s4: He holds his phone out to her, screen away from camera; she glances, rolls her eyes and waves it off. (covers lines 6-9)

s5: Morning light on a long plain stone stairway outdoors, no signs or markers in frame: she climbs with a backpack on each shoulder, breathing hard, silent; he walks beside her, grinning. (covers lines 10-11)
s6: They sit on a stone step; she drops both backpacks at his feet, he laughs and hands her a water bottle. (covers lines 12-13)
